Return to the Profaned Capital Bonfire, climb the ladder on the floor to return to the stone bridge, cross it, and run through the room filled with Jailers to the exit on the other side leading to the corpses praying to Archdragon Peak, where you'll perform the "Path of the Dragon" gesture to teleport there. 12. Archdragon Peak: Go up the cliffside and run along the path, past the Man Serpents, to the first Bonfire, then open the gate to pass through and kill the Ancient Wyvern, following the path around to reach its head with a plunging attack as before. When teleported to the next area, light the Bonfire, then run up the stairs (ignoring the Drakeblood Knight that gets summoned) and into the corridor on the right side (next to the gate) to kill all the Man Serpents in your path until you cross the wooden bridge. Through the stone ruins, run past the Wyvern that touches down and the Stone Lizards waiting to harass you, then through the building beyond with the Man Serpent Mendicant to reach the hall opposite the great bell and light the Bonfire there. Now you have to make your way up the path beyond the doorway next to the Bonfire...and to do so, you basically HAVE to slowly clear out the Man Serpents outside, as they'll otherwise form a crowd literally too thick for you to pass through the doorways in the middle of the road. Once you've gotten everyone but the two large Man Serpents taken care of, run past them and turn left after passing through the last doorway before the slope that leads up to the altar - here, a body holds Havel's Ring+1 (83/107). That's all you need to do here, thankfully; no need to fight the Nameless King...this time. Travel back to the Profaned Capital Bonfire so you can get through that next. 13. Profaned Capital: Descend the ladder leading into the center of the structure and drop through the hole in the wall on the floor, placing you in the street below, so you can run to the left and enter the halls through the stairs on the edge of the cliff.

Proceed through these halls while avoiding the holes (left, right, right, left, right) until you reach the wooden walkway looking over the swamp. Run up the slope against the side of the building here to reach and climb the ladder, then walk along the slanted roof until you reach the "front" of it (with a hole leading to the first Monstrosity of Sin) - drop off the edge here onto a lower roof section, and you can pick up the Flame Stoneplate Ring+1 (84/107). Return to the ladder so you can ascend to the topmost roof (via the stairs that the slanted roof leads to), take out the Court Sorcerer up there, and jump off the edge of the roof toward the hole in the wall next to the stairs so you can climb the stairs and unlock the cell that Siegmeyer's stuck in, enabling his help for Yhorm later. Use the Coiled Sword Fragment to return to the Bonfireand descend the ladder on the outside of the structure, then run across the bridge, taking out the Flame Gargoyle as you go, to reach the interior of the nearby castle. Ignore the Jailer Handmaids and, with one or two Storm Rulers equipped, turn right to pass through the fog and face Yhorm with Siegmeyer once again. Once you win and are transported back to Lothric Castle, collect the Basin of Vows from Emma and defeat the Dancer of the Boreal Valley, then light the Bonfire, use the Basin, and climb the ladder before turning left to enter the Consumed King's Garden. 14. Consumed King's Garden: Collect the Soul of an Old Hand on the walkway and defeat the Cathedral Knight, then ride the lift all the way down and quickly run behind it once it stops at the bottom to pick up the Wood Grain Ring+1 (85/107). Run through the swamp, ignoring ALL the enemies, to pass through the fog on the other side and kill Oceiros.

Once he's down, open the stone doors at the end of his arena, run through the room beyond, and attack the wall at the very end to enter the Untended Graves. 15. Untended Graves: Dash straight through the graveyard toward and past the large stone bowl to the cliff path beyond, where you'll probably be invaded by Daughter of Crystal Kriemhilde; once she's taken care of, make your way down the cliff toward the arena to battle Champion Gundyr. When you can open the doors at the end of the arena, run up the stairs toward the darkened Firelink Shrine, dispatching the two Silver Knights along the way since they'll always aggro onto you, and once inside, climb the stairs to the right to reach the tower outside where, on the right side, you'll find the Ring of Steel Protection+1 (86/107). Now, you've picked up all the other items inside the shrine before...but the true prize lies where Irina of Carim would normally be. Seemingly blocked off by a wall, attack it to dispel the illusion, and you'll find the Eyes of a Fire Keeper on a strange corpse. These are, as it happens, the exact item you need to pursue the second of the three endings that you're aiming for in this playthrough, so make absolutely sure you get it now. Once you do, return to the regular Firelink Shrine with the Coiled Sword Fragment and approach the Fire Keeper to hand over the Eyes of a Fire Keeper, then talk to her again, which will fracture her composure and prompt her to ask if you're sure that you want to commit to the end of fire: choose to Wish for a world without flame, and she'll agree to go along with your plan without informing the others. The option will remain for you to take her off the path and stay on-course to link the fire by killing her and taking the Eyes of a Fire Keeper from her body - but you're committing to this specific ending, so don't worry about that.

Travel to the Dancer of the Boreal Valley Bonfireand climb the ladder, but head forward into Lothric Castle proper this time. 16. Lothric Castle: Rush through the Lothric Knights and up the stairs to the right to reach, light, and rest at the first Bonfire, then run up the NEXT set of stairs and all the enemies on them to the second Bonfire. Proceed through the large archway up the stairs, and on the bridge before the wyverns, immediately drop off the left side onto the ledge closer to the stairs and head along it to the pavilion filled with Hollow soldiers, killing them as you climb the stairs. At the top, run across the center of the path between the two wyverns to the archway next to the golden one, then make your way up through the dark room, dispatching every Hollow you come across, until you reach the top and can descend the stairs leading to the golden wyvern's claw, which will turn into a Pus of Man. As before, just lob Firebombs at it to distract it long enough for you to run in and cut it down with L1 spam. Opposite the archway that the wyvern was sticking his claw through, head outside and turn right to go down some stairs before dropping off the gap in the railing to the ledge below, where a corpse carries the Life Ring+2 (87/107). Use the Coiled Sword Fragment to return to the dark room and go back to the top again, where this time you'll enter the main foyer of the castle and pull the lever to open the main doors while collecting the Soul of a Venerable Old Hand on the right. Drop to the foyer, take out the Lothric Knight and two Hollow Priests, and climb the stairs to reach the area leading to the Dragonslayer Armour. Before going any further, briefly swap in the Silvercat Ring to drop off the left side of the area (through the broken railing) and kill the other Pus of Man on the silver wyvern, then collect the Soul of a Champion from the body hanging over the ledge before heading onto the balcony in the adjoining room and turning right to find the Dark Stoneplate Ring+1 (88/107).

Return to the upper area and pass through the fog to battle the Dragonslayer Armour -you'll likely be alone, but applying Gold Pine Resins will even out the fight pretty well. Light the resulting Bonfire and run past it to the NEXT Bonfire, and once you've collected the key for it from Gotthard's corpse, open the large doors and enter the Grand Archives. 17. Grand Archives: Attack the Crystal Sage until he relocates and start making your way up the stairs, taking out whatever Thralls and Grand Archives Scholars get in your way and dunking your head in wax whenever you can. Up the second flight of stairs after the first wax bath, climb the ladder on the balcony to get a drop on the Crystal Sage, then head up the stairs on the left so you can drop down onto the center bridge and cross it to another set of stairs that you'll turn left at the top of. Keep ascending the stairs and ignore the Grand Archives Scholars to reach the roofs outside; start crossing them and take the slope up to the left, evading the Flame Gargoyles and continuing to follow the rooftops as they curve to the right around the castle until you reach a drop leading to a broken window, where there's a Grand Archives Scholar you HAVE to put down. From the broken window, head to the left and exit again through another archway leading to a pavilion with Kriemhild, Albert, and Kamui waiting for you. This time, you can run past them and take the elevator behind them down to shake them off, then take it back up to head up the stairs to the final bridge. Turn left and climb the stairs toward the tower atop the roof - then run up the rooftop past the Winged Knights and enter the tower from the "ground" to drop down onto the rafters above the cage. Keep dropping down through the rafters until you reach the lower silver ones (with the Man Grub casting spells at you), where you'll want to head to the back-right corner - relative to the opening in the cage - to retrieve the Sage Ring+1 (89/107).

Use the Coiled Sword Fragment to return to the Bonfire and take the lift back up before running across the bridge, past aaaaaaaall the enemies, and cutting down Prince Lothric & Prince Lorian. Now, you can return to the Firelink Shrine and place all the Cinders of a Lord atop their rightful thrones, lighting the way to the Kiln of the First Flame. 18. Kiln of the First Flame: Run up the stairs to the Bonfire and use it to teleport to the main landmass in the distance, then light the final one and climb the steps to face the Soul of Cinder after swapping out whatever Ring of Steel Protection you have for the Flame Stoneplate Ring+1. Once you've won, a summon sign will appear next to the Fire- one for none other than the Fire Keeper, who will come forth to smother the flame and let the age of Dark finally come. If you want to see the secret fourth ending (with no associated trophy) AND feel like an absolute piece of shit, make a backup save before you summon the Fire Keeper and reload it once the trophy pops, then, when you regain control during the end of the cutscene, and you'll see a new cutscene play out...you bastard. Otherwise, it's onto the third and final playthrough!

Welcome to your third, final, and toughest (trophy-related) run of the game, with the most complicated ending to set up and STILL more rings to collect! You'll be following the same rough order of areas as in the first two playthroughs, but this time, you'll actually be following Yoel's storyline and taking Anri's in a, well...different direction for the final ending, the Usurpation of Fire. Let's begin: 1. Cemetery of Ash: SHOW SPOILER Run through to the end of the first area and onto the cliff overlooking Firelink Shrine; light the Bonfire here and run down to the arena to pull out the Coiled Sword and take on Iudex Gundyr. Once you open the doors behind him, immediately turn left to find a corpse bearing the Wolf Ring +2 (90/107) against the wall. Through the doors, run up to the Firelink Shrine and talk to the Fire Keeper, then insert the Coiled Sword into the Bonfire and Travel to the High Wall of Lothric. 2. High Wall of Lothric: Open the door and descend the stairs to light the Bonfire before heading down the left set of stairs and entering the building underneath the dead wyvern to go down the ladder. On the walkway outside, ignore the stairs and cut a path through the Hollows toward the Lothric Knight to reach and light the Bonfire on the top floor behind him. From the floor below the Bonfire, go down the stairs and through the doorway to the rooftops outside. After taking out the Pus of Man in the center of the praying Hollows, descend the ladder and enter the room next to it to dispatch the Lothric Knight, then head through the archway at the end to reach the two-story room filled with Hollows. Once you've taken them all out (even at your heightened level, they can kill you quickly if you're caught in the middle of a group, so try to lure them away one at a time), run to the far corner of the room - to the level of the anvil with an Estus Shard - and break a barrel to get the Ring of the Evil Eye+2 (91/107).

Return to the rooftops and descend the ladders to cross the pavilion below, cutting a swathe through the patrolling Lothric Knights on the stairs to first enter the cathedral on the left and speak to Emma for the Small Lothric Banner, then descend to take out Vordt of the Boreal Valley and cross through the doors behind him to fly to the Undead Settlement. 3. A Dark Detour: Light the Bonfire and run down to the broken bridge to recruit Yoel from the far end of it, then return to Firelink Shrine and speak to him (at the end of the corridor just past Hawkwood) to Draw Out True Strength; this will consist of him giving you a free level up in a stat of your choice...but in exchange, you'll be branded with the Dark Sigil (viewable in your Key Items), which will set you on the path toward the Usurpation of Fire. Now, you need to have 5 Dark Sigils before defeating the Abyss Watchers in order to progress to the next stage of the ending quest, but Yoel won't immediately offer to level you up again - instead, you need to go throw yourself off a cliff and die in order to begin Hollowing, which is tracked underneath your level in the Player Status submenu. Once you've done so twice (ideally from the Iudex Gundyr Bonfire for the sake of speed while retrieving your Souls every time, of course) and reached 2 Hollowing, return to Yoel and he'll give you another Dark Sigil along with a second free level. Now, every time you die, your Hollowing will go up by 2 instead of 1, which will continue increasing with every Dark Sigil you acquire. Die two more times to reach 6 Hollowing and Draw Out True Strength again to get a third Dark Sigil. From here, you only have to reach 15 Hollowing to finish Yoel's portion of the quest, so die three more times - shriveling up and disfiguring your Ashen One -and Draw Out True Strength with him twice more to receive your fourth and fifth Dark Sigils.

Attempting to Draw Out True Strength any more after this will have Yoel simply state that you're strong enough and will soon know more, so leave and come back to the Firelink Shrine...and you'll be met by a strange woman standing near Yoel's corpse in that same corridor, Yuria of Londor. 4. A Dark Detour (cont'd): Yep, this is the central NPC for this quest, and she has quite a few things for you. Talk to her, and Yuria will teach you her gesture, "Dignified Bow" (32/33), as well as sell you the Untrue Dark Ring (92/107) and Untrue White Ring (93/107)..oh, and the Londor Braille Divine Tome, which you'll give to Karla later for the last three miracles. Once you've gotten those, Yuria will be on standby for several more areas, so return to the Foot of the High Wall Bonfire. 5. Undead Settlement: Run down the stairs through the gate and light the Bonfire on the other side. Through the tunnel, hug the right side of the open area with the large tree to avoid most of the enemies and take the bridge on the right, then take the rocky path to the right of the stables to climb up the ladder against the house. Drop off the right side toward the pacing Hollow Manservant, equip the Silvercat Ring, and fall off the end of the cliff facing the tower to open the door and enter, where Siegmeyer will come down on the lift; talk to him to start HIS storyline and take the lift down, then back up to get him up the tower. Manipulate the lifts to get the top one lowered to ground level before turning to face the entrance and riding the top lift up, which will let you step off onto the wooden platform leading to Siegmeyer's next location. Descend into the pavilion and battle the Fire Demon with Siegmeyer, making sure he survives and that you exhaust his dialogue after - then, head into the main building and make your way up to the room with the two Evangelists. Kill them and head onto the wooden platform outside to drop off the right side onto a rooftop, on the far side of which lies the Covetous Silver Serpent Ring+2 (94/107).

Return to the lift tower (via the Coiled Sword Fragment) and descend on the lower lift to the basement that leads to the Road of Sacrifices; up to you if you want to use the door exploit against the Outrider Knight this time, as he's much easier to put down now. 6. Road of Sacrifices: Light and rest at the Bonfire before heading along the main path, dispatching the Corvians, and after taking out the Corvian Shaman on the left, drop off the left side of the cliff he was standing on to land on a ledge (look over the side to find it first) with the Chloranthy Ring+2 (95/107). Return to the Bonfire with the Coiled Sword Fragment and follow the path until you cross the bridge at the end to reach Anri and Horace, as well as the next Bonfire - this time, you do need to see their storyline through (specifically Anri's other storyline path), so talk to them both to move them along. Descend to the swamp and stay on the edge of the shore as you make your way left, killing the Lycanthrope Hunters along the way, until you reach the next Bonfire. After lighting it, run into the ruins on the left, up the stairs and straight along the path, to reach and defeat the Crystal Sage, whom you can cut down before he even has a chance to teleport. From there, take the left path toward the Cathedral of the Deep. 7. Cathedral of the Deep: Run along the path and across the bridge to light the Bonfire, then take out the Brigand and Fallen Knight on the stairs before dashing past all the enemies in that hellhole stretch of forest to reach the Cleansing Chapel beyond. Once you've lit the Bonfire inside, head up the slope to the left of the entrance into the winding dirt corridors, favoring the ones on the right so you can reach the top of the cathedral.

Keep going up the stairs until you reach the large blue doors on the top level, then turn right, clear out the Hollows, and navigate the buttresses on the left side to reach the lower platform with the two archers. Cross the bridge from here leading up to the platform with the two Grave Wardens and, from there, open the blue doors up the stairs to enter the cathedral. Proceed through the rooms until you reach the ledge guarded by the Giant Slave, then run for your life along it to the other side and descend all three flights of stairs to face the Cathedral Knight among the pews. Take the stairs on the left up to the main hall, defeat Kirk when he invades, and pull both levers (one among the pillars to the left, the other at the far corner of the pool to the right) to raise the two walls. Past the lever between the pillars, enter the archway on the right and descend the stairs to reach the path outside leading to a shortcut back to the Bonfire; just before the door leading into the chapel (make sure to open it), turn right and open the door to the tower to take the lift inside. At the top, kill the Hollow and head onto the ledge to reach the ladder, take that up to dispatch the Deacon at the top and drop onto the buttress from the hole in the corner, then run up that, kill the large Hollow on the left, and collect the Ring of Favor+2 (96/107) behind him to immediately equip (if you don't have the +3 version). Use the Coiled Sword Fragment and return to the main room of the chapel, where you'll climb the stairs next to the Giant Slave on the right and run past the Cathedral Knight and Deacons toward the archway on the left, leading to the lift that'll take you to the front of the hall. Down the stairs past the blue doors here (make sure to open them), you'll find Patches impersonating Siegmeyer again; kill him and collect the armor.

Briefly, return to the Cleansing Chapel to return Siegmeyer's armor to him in the well outside, then head back inside the main cathedral through the shortcut and retrace your steps across the raised walls to the pews you ran past earlier. Go up to the tilted altar, summon Anri and Horace, and pass through the fog to defeat the Deacons of the Deep for the Small Doll. Go back to Firelink Shrine to find Anri and exhaust their dialogue, then return to the Crucifixion Woods Bonfire and run across the swamp toward the strait on the other side, using the ladder trick to kill the Exile Watchdogs once again, to reach the Farron Keep. 8. Farron Keep: From the new Bonfire, head outside and turn left toward the stairs in the distance, which you'll climb to extinguish the first flame. Through the archway, take the left path leading down and cross the straits of land to extinguish the second flame. Through the arch here, turn right and follow the wall all the way around to a tree to pick up the Dark Stoneplate Ring+2 (97/107). Across the bridge from the second flame, take out the Ghrus and light the next Bonfire, then, in the swamp below, follow the trail of bonfires to the right, kill the Elder Ghrus, and extinguish the final flame to open the doors before using the Coiled Sword Fragment to return to the Bonfire. Go down the steps and through the stone door, then up the path toward the two Darkwraiths - turn right at the point they start from and enter the ruins to reach the next Bonfire, from the corner of which you can summon none other than the Londor Pale Shade to receive the final gesture, "Duel Bow" (33/33)!...though, in all honesty, Black Hand Gotthard just outside the arena will fare better in the boss battle.

Make sure most or all of the enemies outside are dead before battling the Abyss Watchers, then descend the stairs behind the new Bonfire to enter the Catacombs of Carthus. 9. Catacombs of Carthus: Cross the bridge until you get close to the arch on the other side, then look over the left edge toward a pillar with an item on it; drop down to collect the Ring of Steel Protection+2 (98/107), then return to the Bonfire with the Coiled Sword Fragment and cross the bridge again to descend the stairs on the other side. From the bottom of those stairs, BEFORE heading toward the slope that the first Skeleton Boulder rolls down, turn left into a hallway and head down the stairs at the end to find Anri, whose dialogue you'll want to exhaust again; then return to the slope and run down it. Once you reach the bottom and the gate with the Bonfire behind it, follow the path around to light the next Bonfire, and take the stairs in front of the next Skeleton Boulder down to the long hall, where turning left and taking the exit at the end will bring you into the adjoining cave. Turn right into the bone-filled cavern and, looking at the bridge, take the path to the right through the stalagmites to find Anri again and tell them that you don't know where Horace is. Once you've done so, go back down and cross the bridge, cutting it down to dispatch the horde of Skeletons following you, before opening the doors at the end and interacting with the chalice on the table to battle High Lord Wolnir (this time around, you can kill him much more safely, or at least speed up the actual fight, by slowly approaching him on the right side, without alerting him, and repeatedly casting Pestilent Mist to drain his HP). Once he's dead, light the Bonfire and double back to the bridge to descend it as a ladder. Run through the stone room down here, using the Mimic to kill the Fire Demon again, and light the Bonfire at the end before entering the Smouldering Lake through the tunnel. 10. Smouldering Lake:

Run to the right-center area of the lake and use the Giant Avelyn to destroy the stony section of the ground, letting you drop into the ruins below. From where you drop, turn left (toward the Demon Cleric) and enter the room behind him to light the next Bonfire, then take the stairs down and follow the path until you reach the narrow hallway that turns right (past the room with the Demon Statues). Turn left here and attack the wall to dispel the illusion, then run to the right side of the far end of the room, past the Black Knight, and retrieve the Flame Stoneplate Ring+2 (99/107) from a demon corpse. Travel back to the High Lord Wolnir Bonfire and proceed into Irithyll of the Boreal Valley. 11. Irithyll of the Boreal Valley: Light the Bonfire and rush across the bridge, killing the Sulyvahn's Beast that chases you so you don't have to deal with it in the water later, to light the next Bonfire and begin heading up the slope, taking out the Pontiff Knights as you go. Up the first set of stairs, you'll want to prioritize the Fire Witches before dealing with the Irithyllian Slaves, as they'll be able to target you from further away than any other enemy. As you keep going, turn left before the large archway to enter the church and light the next Bonfire. Anri should be standing against the right wall - if they're not, then the questline for the ending will be messed up - so exhaust their dialogue and leave via the stairs without killing the assassin in the corner. In the graveyard, turn left and head down the slope into the dark room of Irithyllian Slaves, where you'll run across to the balcony on the far side and take the stairs down from into the water, then cross all the way to the other side to light the Bonfire inside the tower.

Double back outside and head into the tunnel midway along the wall, running past and ignoring the Sewer Centipedes to reach the stairs on the other side, where you should exhaust Siegward's dialogue again before proceeding into the room beyond with the Silver Knights and paintings. Run out the door on the other end and turn right to find the Wood Grain Ring+2 (100/107) in an alcove. Head up the stairs, and since you're working with Yuria, the Londor Pale Shade won't invade you this time, hooray! Dispatch the other enemies, then continue up the next set of stairs beyond the statue at the top, as well as the stairs inside the building. Ignoring the Irithyllian Slaves, take out the two Pontiff Knights at the top of the stairs beyond the building and enter the fog, with or without the Londor Pale Shade/Black Hand Gotthard, to kick Pontiff Sulyvahn's ass again. After lighting the Bonfire, return to Firelink Shrine and speak twice to Yuria, who will tell you that Anri awaits you for marriage in the temple of the Darkmoon, then head back to the Pontiff Sulyvahn Bonfire, head outside, and turn left toward Anor Londo. 12. Anor Londo: Drop into the hall under the bridge, exit on the other side, climb the stairs, and dash through the crowd of Deacons to ascend the stairs inside the tower and head up the connecting buttress - it's best to run like hell past the Silver Knights up here until you reach the second buttress leading down to a lower platform, where you'll want to head inside the connecting archway and turn right to reach the former boss arena of Gwyndolin. Here, a servant of Yuria on the left (in fact, the same one hidden in the church), when spoken to, will give you the Sword of Avowal to complete your ceremony with. Run all the way to the end of the hall to find and press against it to trigger a cutscene, which will reward you with the final three Dark Sigils - you're now locked into the ending, so all you need to worry about now are the remaining collectibles.

Go up the stairs and pull the lever that'll lower the rotating bridge, then rotate the bridge with the lever at the top and walk onto the adjoining bridge to light the Bonfire, which you should use to return to Yuria and speak to her once more so she can congratulate you on your vows and assure you that you're set to become the next Lord of Hollows. Back in Anor Londo, from the Bonfire, go down the stairs in the bridge without lowering it again and walk off the edge of the archway into the open air, toward the front of the nearby tower, so you can cross the invisible bridge and drop off to the next Bonfire. Inside the tower, start dropping down the beams, and after collecting the Painting Guardian Set, drop onto the rightmost beam and walk backward toward the small platform attached to it to pick up Havel's Ring+2 (101/107) before Traveling to the Anor Londo Bonfire. Dash up the stairs past the Silver Knights and turn left to reach the corpse of the Giant Blacksmith inside the tower, then ascend the stairs to enter the main cathedral, inside of which you'll want to descend the stairs on the left to dispatch the five Deacons that'll be hurling fireballs at you BEFORE reaching the floor and dashing into the fog door to exterminate Aldrich. Once you're done, Travel to the Distant Manor Bonfire that you lit earlier and descend into Irithyll Dungeon. 13. Irithyll Dungeon: After dispatching the Fire Witch and Pontiff Knight waiting for you below, you'll be invaded by Alva, Seeker of the Spurned on the steps outside, and once you deal with him (or he deals with you...strong bastard, he is), you can descend the stairs in the cliff he emerged from to reach the first Bonfire. On the stone hallway outside, kill the first Jailers as you come across them and cross the bridge, then enter the first cell on the right and cross through the holes in the walls to the hall on the other side of the locked door, which you'll want to drop down from to reach the lower hall.

Run outside (to the left) from here to reach the outdoor stairs overlooking the Profaned Capital and head down the stairs to enter a corridor filled with Hollows; turning right and running all the way to the end will let you pick up another Soul of an Old Hand. Descend the ladder from the other exit here and open the door to reach the sleeping Giant Slave - briefly swap in the Silvercat Ring and drop off the ledge here to safely SHOW SPOILER reach the ground floor, then run into the tunnel on the left to reach the lift connecting to the first Bonfire. Back in the room with the Giant Slave, take the stairs on the opposite side and climb the ladder before heading through the small doorway to land on the overhang above the narrow bridge, which you'll want to drop down onto so you can enter the sewer grate. After running all the way to the end to open the chest and collect the Old Cell Key, take the first right in here, kill the two Giant Rats that attack you, and lift up the gate to enter the room with the patrolling Jailers so you can run past them (to the right) to the stairs outside. Cross the bridge, kill the Flame Gargoyle that flies down, and climb the ladder inside the structure to light the Bonfire. Return to the stone bridge, cross it, and run through the room filled with Jailers (via the hall on the right) to the exit on the other side leading to the corpses praying to Archdragon Peak, where you'll perform the "Path of the Dragon" gesture to teleport there. 14. Archdragon Peak: Go up the cliffside and run along the path, past the Man Serpents, to the first Bonfire, then open the gate to pass through and kill the Ancient Wyvern, following the path around to reach its head with a plunging attack as before.

When teleported to the next area, light the Bonfire, then run up the stairs (ignoring the Drakeblood Knight that gets summoned) and into the corridor on the right side (next to the gate) to kill all the Man Serpents in your path until you cross the wooden bridge. Through the stone ruins, run past the Wyvern that touches down and the Stone Lizards waiting to harass you, then through the building beyond with the Man Serpent Mendicant to reach the hall opposite the great bell and light the Bonfire there - make sure to rest too. Sigh...pull the lever and ring the great bell. Yep, it's time to battle the Nameless King again - this is the only boss aside from the Soul of Cinder that you're going to find harder than you did on the first run, as your equipment won't have improved drastically between then and now compared to other bosses. Human Pine Resins and the Thunder Stoneplate Ring+1 are vital here to even the playing field, but you can still expect this to take the most attempts of any boss on this run. Once he's down, head to the third staircase on the right side of the path that you end up in, and you can pick up the Covetous Gold Serpent Ring+2 (102/107); so worth it, right? Light the new Bonfire and Travel to the Profaned Capital Bonfire. 15. Profaned Capital: Descend the ladder leading into the center of the structure and drop through the hole in the wall on the floor, placing you in the street below, so you can turn right down the stairs and keep doing until you reach the broken edge of the street beyond the next set of stairs. On the left side of the steps, you'll find the Magic Stoneplate Ring+2 (103/107). Double back up the street and turn right into the hole in the wall at the other end to enter the winding halls. Proceed through these halls while avoiding the holes (left, right, right, left, right) until you reach the wooden walkway looking over the swamp. Run up the slope against the side of the building here to reach and climb the ladder, then walk along the slanted roof until you can ascend to the topmost roof (via the stairs that the slanted roof leads to), take out the Court Sorcerer up there, and jump off the edge of the roof toward the hole in the wall next to the stairs so you can climb the stairs and unlock the cell that Siegmeyer's stuck in, enabling his help for Yhorm later.

Drop back down to the stairs and take them up to the corridor at the end, leading to the Jailer's Key Ring, then use the Coiled Sword Fragment to return to the Bonfire and descend the central ladder again to cross the bridge leading back to Irithyll Dungeon. In the room filled with Jailers, head up the stairs on the left side onto the ledge with the cells, cut down the one Jailer in the tunnel, and open the cell at the end to rescue Karla, choosing to help her during both dialogue options. Use the Coiled Sword Fragment again to return to Firelink Shrine, head to Karla's spot to the left of Andrea, and choose to learn dark sorceries from her. Finally, you can hand her the Londor Braille Divine Tome (though you'll have to do so twice for her to accept) and, for a mere 30,000 Souls, learn Dark Blade (33/35), Vow of Silence (34/35) (very useful), and Dead Again (35/35)! Back at the Profaned Capital Bonfire, take the ladder on the outside of the structure down, then run across the bridge, taking out the Flame Gargoyle as you go, to reach the interior of the nearby castle. Ignore the Jailer Handmaids and, with a Storm Ruler equipped, turn right to pass through the fog and face Yhorm with Siegmeyer once again. (If, like the author, you screwed up his storyline in this playthrough and are stuck facing Yhorm alone, you'll benefit greatly from Reinforcing one of your Storm Rulers to +5, either with the Titanite Scales you have on-hand or by buying them from the Handmaid after collecting the Dragon Chaser's Ashes from Archdragon Peak, where you can also get a Titanite Slab from the Nameless King's arena.) Once you win and are transported back to Lothric Castle, collect the Basin of Vows from Emma and defeat the Dancer of the Boreal Valley, then light the Bonfire, use the Basin, and climb the ladder before turning left to enter the Consumed King's Garden. 16. Consumed King's Garden:

Collect the Soul of an Old Hand on the walkway and defeat the Cathedral Knight, then ride the lift down until you see the upper ledge; walk off onto this and turn left once outside to find the usual broken set of stairs at the end of the walkway. It'll be a little tricky, but you need to drop onto this, turn around to face the OTHER broken stairs adjacent to the top of these stairs, and make a running jump off said top of these stairs to reach the Sage Ring+2 (104/107). Run through the swamp, ignoring ALL the enemies, to pass through the fog on the other side and kill Oceiros. Once he's down, open the stone doors at the end of his arena, run through the room beyond, and attack the wall at the very end to enter the Untended Graves. 17. Untended Graves: Dash straight through the graveyard toward and past the large stone bowl to the cliff path beyond, where you'll probably be invaded by Daughter of Crystal Kriemhilde; once she's taken care of, make your way down the cliff toward the arena to battle Champion Gundyr. When you can open the doors at the end of the arena, run up the stairs toward the darkened Firelink Shrine, dispatching the two Silver Knights along the way since they'll always aggro onto you, and once inside, retrieve and equip the Life Ring+3 (105/107) from behind the central of the five thrones. Travel to the Dancer of the Boreal Valley Bonfire and climb the ladder, but head forward into Lothric Castle proper this time. 18. Lothric Castle: Rush through the Lothric Knights and up the stairs to the right to reach, light, and rest at the first Bonfire, then run up the NEXT set of stairs and all the enemies on them to the second Bonfire. Proceed through the large archway up the stairs, and on the bridge before the wyverns, immediately drop off the left side onto the ledge closer to the stairs and head along it to the pavilion filled with Hollow soldiers, killing them as you climb the stairs.

At the top, run across the center of the path between the two wyverns to the archway next to the golden one, then make your way up through the dark room, dispatching every Hollow you come across, until you reach the top and can descend the stairs leading to the golden wyvern's claw, which will turn into a Pus of Man. As before, just lob Firebombs at it to distract it long enough for you to run in and cut it down with L1 spam. Use the Coiled Sword Fragment and cross the bridge unhindered to return to the dark room and go back to the top again, where this time you'll enter the main foyer of the castle and pull the lever to open the main doors while collecting the Soul of a Venerable Old Hand on the right. Drop to the foyer, take out the Lothric Knight and two Hollow Priests, and climb the stairs to reach the area leading to the Dragonslayer Armour. Activate the elevator and take it back up before turning right here and entering the small cathedral lit by torches. Inside, head up the stairs and turn left to reach a balcony with a broken section of the railing on the left. Drop through this to the slanted rooftop below and, in front of the window on the wall at the rightmost edge, you'll find the Thunder Stoneplate Ring+2 (106/107). Return to the upper area (via using the Coiled Sword Fragment, Traveling to the Dancer of the Boreal Valley Bonfire, taking the ladder up into the castle, and riding the elevator on the left side of the corpse room up to the top) and pass through the fog to battle the Dragonslayer Armour - you'll likely be alone, but applying Gold Pine Resins will even out the fight pretty well. Light the resulting Bonfire and run past it to the NEXT Bonfire, and once you've collected the key for it from Gotthard's corpse, open the large doors and enter the Grand Archives. 19. Grand Archives:

Attack the Crystal Sage until he relocates and start making your way up the stairs, taking out whatever Thralls and Grand Archives Scholars get in your way and dunking your head in wax whenever you can. Up the second flight of stairs after the first wax bath, climb the ladder on the balcony to get a drop on the Crystal Sage, then head up the stairs on the left so you can drop down onto the center bridge and cross it to another set of stairs that you'll turn left at the top of. Keep ascending the stairs and ignore the Grand Archives Scholars to reach the roofs outside; start crossing them and take the slope up to the left, evading the Flame Gargoyles and continuing to follow the rooftops as they curve to the right around the castle until you reach a drop leading to a broken window, where there's a Grand Archives Scholar you HAVE to put down. From the broken window, head to the left and exit again through another archway leading to a pavilion with Kriemhild, Albert, and Kamui waiting for you. This time, you can run past them and take the elevator behind them down to shake them off, then take it back up to head up the stairs to the final bridge. Turn left and climb the stairs toward the tower atop the roof - then run up the rooftop past the Winged Knights and climb the stairs on the right side of the tower. At the top, rather than take the ladder up, circle around to the "front" of the tower and enter the small alcove there to pick up the Lingering Dragoncrest Ring+2 (107/107), ending your ring quest at long last! Use the Coiled Sword Fragment to return to the Bonfire and take the lift back up before running across the bridge, past aaaaaaaall the enemies, and cutting down Prince Lothric & Prince Lorian. Now, you can return to the Firelink Shrine and place all the Cinders of a Lord atop their rightful thrones, lighting the way to the Kiln of the First Flame. 20. Kiln of the First Flame:

Run up the stairs to the Bonfire and use it to teleport to the main landmass in the distance, then light the final one and climb the steps to face the Soul of Cinder after swapping out whatever Ring of Steel Protection you have for the Flame Stoneplate Ring+2 and prepping your Red Bug Pellets/Gold Pine Resins. On the way up, you can also summon the Londor Pale Shade from the last melted pillar on the right before the arena entrance, as well as Yuria herself from directly in front of the entrance; however, in the author's experience, the distraction they provided wasn't worth the boosted defense of the Soul of Cinder by any stretch. One new tweak to the battle, though, is that (with sufficient FTH and after equipping the Deep Ring or Darkmoon Ring) you now have access to Vow of Silence, and using it with a chime when the Soul of Cinder transitions to his staff style will render him completely helpless until he switches again, letting you cut him to pieces with impunity. Once you've defeated the incarnation of kings for the last time, approach the First Flame and choose to Link the Fire...but this time, a very different cutscene will play, crowning you instead as the Lord of Hollows who's finally combined Fire and Dark to rule over the new age. Vendrick would be proud! Congratulations on your successful quest through the end of the world, and regardless of this being the finale to end all finales, hopefully you had a damn good time.
